c-gating-roster-role-is-a-per-person-dec.evidence: PMPro level pmpro_3 membership rule on QA-WALK-B3 Private, Sync Members -> toast 'Synced 5 existing members.'; the synced people are listed on the Members tab.
DB roster of the space: rows added by the rule (source tier) all role member (4 rows), none moderator or admin.
Members tab: Grace changed to Moderator -> toast 'Role updated.'; after another Sync Members ('Synced 0 existing members.') she is still moderator; restored to Member.
GET /spaces/{id}/members as admin -> 200, roles as shown on the Members tab (admin first).

bob PATCH /spaces/37/members/3754 role=moderator -> 200 (reverted to member 200); the same PATCH in another space -> 403 jetonomy_forbidden 'You do not have permission to perform this action.' (runbook wording now matches).
A roster member PATCH own role=admin -> 403 jetonomy_forbidden; role unchanged.
Demote the only admin to Member on the Members tab -> 'This space must keep at least one admin. Promote someone else first.'; role still admin after reload.
Members tab with 127 roster rows: pager '1-50 of 127' with pages 1, 2, 3 and Next, a search box; searching 'grace' (?ms=grace) lists only Grace Oluwaseun Adeyemi-Whitfield.
1440px: Grace's row is 1236x56, name on one line inside the row, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 1440).
390px Members tab: Grace row 366x60, scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth, rows stack.

Admin POST /spaces/{id}/members {user_id: 3752} and {user_id: 3756} (neither on the roster) -> 409 jetonomy_already_member 'You are already in this space.' for both; the route ignores user_id and only joins the caller, so no other person can be added to the roster by REST. Runbook still expects the person to be added.

proposed_checks.text: @admin #admin +many: the space Members tab with more than 50 people pages at 50 rows and its search box finds a member on a later page.
@admin #rest !refuse: POST /spaces/{id}/members with a user_id as staff -> 201 and the person is on the roster; the same call as a subscriber -> 403; repeating it for the same user -> 409.
